message: The other night, as the storm rolled in, our family group chat buzzed like a beehive—"Did you hear that thunder?" "Is it safe to keep the windows open?" Between the jokes about my son’s new raincoat and my daughter’s insistence that the thunder was just the sky’s way of sneezing, I realized how nice it is to share those little moments. If you ever find yourself wondering how to prepare for a storm, I stumbled across a handy resource that covers the basics. It's a gentle reminder to keep our loved ones safe while we laugh through the chaos. What’s your go-to storm snack? 🌩️
